question: Across a fresh six-seed block, does the non-carrier assertion readout Y_ind exist and does the K/Y_ind order vary in both directions?

design.acquisition: PHASE_ACQUISITION schedule, source env_acq inside the acquisition window

readouts.Y_ind: assertion from all candidate types except loop_candidate and dream
readouts.K: assertion from loop_candidate and dream only

outcomes.C6 ORDER VARIATION CONFIRMED: N1 and N3 pass on all six seeds; every seed has at least 10 K_BEFORE_Y_IND and at least 10 Y_IND_BEFORE_K; both orders occur on at least 5 of 6 seeds.
outcomes.C6 NOT SEPARATED: N1 and N3 pass, but the per-order floor or the 5-of-6 coverage rule is not met.
outcomes.C6 NOT MEASURABLE: Any seed has no edge with Y_ind.
outcomes.VOID: Any N1, N3 or engine-pin gate fails.

falsifiers: A seed with zero Y_ind edges makes C6 not measurable for this block.
A seed with only one order means the block does not establish order variation.
An N1 or N3 failure voids the block; the observer is not trusted.
A changed engine pin voids the block; this is not the pinned build.

authorisation.quote: Preregister the C6 seed block and minimum per-order counts, then run the remaining seeds.
